h1: Custom 13 oz Barware for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Shop custom 13 oz barware for your next event. Personalize with logos. Bulk pricing available from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 13 oz barware hits a sweet spot for serving standard pours of beer, cider, or cocktails without the weight of a full pint. These 13 oz glasses are ideal for brewery events, corporate happy hours, or restaurant branded glassware. Decorate with screen printing or etching for a polished look that stands up to commercial dishwashers. Ordering in bulk keeps per-unit costs low while giving your staff or guests a sturdy, everyday glass that carries your logo.
heroAltText: Custom 13 oz barware glasses with engraved logo, set on a wooden bar table
